activity.notes: The Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial records that Witold Pilecki arrived at Auschwitz on 22 September 1940, co-founded the camp resistance, and escaped during the night of 26/27 April 1943. ATLAS encodes this as opposition to the German regime, never as service to Germany, and limits the rail to the documented Auschwitz resistance interval.

sources.citation_text: The Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial records Pilecki's arrival at Auschwitz on 22 September 1940, his role in organizing resistance there, and his escape during the night of 26/27 April 1943.
